name: Nursemaid's Elbow / Radial Head Subluxation
definition: Subluxation of the radial head due to annular ligament displacement, typically after longitudinal traction on the arm in toddlers.

core: Check for focal bony tenderness before reduction

investigations.principle: Imaging is not needed in classic presentation without trauma red flags.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: If reduction fails or exam is atypical, obtain imaging and reconsider diagnosis.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Balaka Kurpara-Sandhi displacement may be documented only after modern assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Subluxation of the radial head due to annular ligament displacement, typically after longitudinal traction on the arm in toddlers.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
